results.Add a clear and prominent notice explain: Add a clear and prominent notice explaining when and how users interact with AI.
results.Assign owners and evidence for each miss: Assign owners and evidence for each missing or unverified control.
results.Confirm the processing inventory, lawful: Confirm the processing inventory, lawful bases, notices, roles, and records of processing.
results.Determine whether the company is a GPAI: Determine whether the company is a GPAI provider or downstream deployer and document the applicable duties.
results.Document the AI value-chain role and cla: Document the AI value-chain role and classify each AI system before deployment.
results.Extra EU/EEA providers or transfers shou: Extra EU/EEA providers or transfers should be mapped and verified.
results.Keep the profile current and repeat the: Keep the profile current and repeat the assessment when processing or AI use changes.
results.Map destinations and vendors, then verif: Map destinations and vendors, then verify the transfer mechanism and supplementary measures.
results.No major risk signal was detected from t: No major risk signal was detected from the current questionnaire answers.
results.No major warning from current answers: No major warning from current answers
results.Pause deployment until the selected prac: Pause deployment until the selected practice has been reviewed against the prohibited-practices rules.
results.Perform a documented high-risk classific: Perform a documented high-risk classification review and map the applicable provider or deployer duties.
results.Potential prohibited or sensitive AI pra: Potential prohibited or sensitive AI practices were selected. Review before deployment or sale.
results.Run and document a DPIA screening. The q: Run and document a DPIA screening. The questionnaire signals do not by themselves establish that a full DPIA is mandatory. Complete a DPIA before processing if the screening shows likely high risk; consult the supervisory authority under Article 36 only if the DPIA shows high residual risk without adequate mitigation.
results.Some expected controls are missing or un: Some expected controls are missing or unclear:
results.The AI use case may fall into AI Act hig: The AI use case may fall into AI Act high-risk areas such as HR, education, credit, healthcare, or critical infrastructure.
results.The answers suggest profiling, sensitive: The answers suggest profiling, sensitive data, minors data, or high-risk processing.
results.The selected answers indicate DPIA scree: The selected answers indicate DPIA screening factors, but the questionnaire alone does not establish that a full DPIA is mandatory. A DPIA is required when the planned processing is likely to result in high risk; prior consultation follows only when the DPIA identifies high residual risk without adequate mitigation.

ui.assessment_1: Select Calculate assessment to evaluate the answers and prepare the dashboard results.
ui.assessment_3: After calculating an assessment, select Go to dashboard to open the results.
ui.assistant_disclaimer: Dr. A uses an AI model that cross-references the company profile, regulatory sources, and news. Its answers are not legal advice or a guarantee of legal compliance.
ui.chat_empty: Load a profile, then ask a question about the result.
ui.chat_placeholder: E.g. What are the first three things this company should do?
ui.dashboard_assistant_text: Dr. A answers questions using the company profile, regulatory material, and available news. Its responses are operational guidance and not legal advice.
ui.dashboard_loaded: Profile loaded. You can ask Dr. A to explain the score, warnings, or next actions.
ui.dashboard_news_events: Regulatory events display structured updates matched to the company profile.
ui.dashboard_news_refresh: Use Refresh news to retrieve updated sources when available.
ui.dashboard_news_updates: Relevant news shows updates filtered according to sector, role, and risk indicators.
ui.dashboard_score_text: This section summarizes the assessment score, priority areas, and the reasons those priorities were identified.
ui.dashboard_timeline_text: The timeline shows AI Act milestones related to the current company profile. Dates should always be checked against official sources.
ui.dashboard_warnings_text: Warnings highlight sensitive answers, possible high-risk indicators, missing controls, or information requiring verification.
ui.demo_notice: DEMO MODE: updates come from the local dataset. Select Refresh news to read current official sources online.
ui.early_warning_notice: Non-binding analysis and news: these items are not law and must be verified against official sources.
ui.early_warning_title: Early warning signals from trusted sources
ui.empty_summary: Load the JSON downloaded from the questionnaire to see the personalized dashboard.
ui.live_notice: LIVE SOURCES: updates collected from official sources and filtered for this profile. Last checked:
ui.load_json_alert: Select the JSON downloaded from the questionnaire.
ui.loading_1: Use Choose file and Load questionnaire to import a previously exported JSON file.
ui.loading_2: Use demo questionnaires to populate realistic SaaS, HR AI, or GPAI provider scenarios.
ui.loading_3: Review the answers before calculating the assessment.
ui.loading_text: You can continue from an existing questionnaire or start from a sample company profile.
ui.no_profile_progress: Load or calculate an assessment to display progress.
ui.no_snapshot_history: No saved snapshot history yet. The current assessment is shown on its own.
ui.no_source: Official source not available in the feed
ui.progress_disclaimer: These indicators support planning and do not certify legal compliance.
ui.progress_intro: Track risk attention, control coverage, priorities, and deadlines from the current company profile.
ui.questionnaire_answer_1: Answer from the perspective of the company being assessed.
ui.questionnaire_answer_2: Select every checkbox option that applies.
ui.questionnaire_answer_3: Use 'I do not know' only when the answer is genuinely unclear.
ui.questionnaire_answer_4: Add notes when additional context may affect the assessment.
ui.questionnaire_intro: Fill it in, change the flags, load an already completed questionnaire or use a demo. Then calculate the assessment and move to the dashboard.
ui.questionnaire_language_warning: The full questionnaire dictionary for this language is not available yet: the questionnaire remains in Italian.
ui.questionnaire_overview_text: The questionnaire collects the information needed to estimate how the EU AI Act may apply to your company, products, data usage, and existing controls.
ui.qwen_missing: Local dashboard - Dr. A not connected to the model
ui.report_disclaimer: This report supports prioritisation and does not constitute legal advice or certify legal compliance.
ui.risk_direction_note: A lower risk-attention score indicates fewer detected warning signals; it is not a compliance percentage.
ui.snapshot_compare: Use Compare snapshots to highlight differences between two assessments.
ui.snapshot_delete: Use Delete snapshot to remove the selected saved profile.
ui.snapshot_load: Use Load saved snapshot to restore a previously saved profile.
ui.snapshot_save: Use Save assessment snapshot to store the current questionnaire state.
ui.snapshot_trend_intro: Saved snapshots are shown chronologically; the current unsaved assessment is added for comparison.
ui.snapshots_text: Snapshots store assessment states locally so they can be restored or compared later.
ui.timeline_embedded_high_risk: Product-embedded high-risk system rules under the 2026 simplification agreement
ui.timeline_enforcement: Commission enforcement powers for GPAI obligations apply
ui.timeline_general: General AI Act rules and Article 50 transparency obligations apply
ui.timeline_gpai: Governance rules and GPAI obligations apply

ui.timeline_notice: Dates are personalised from the current profile and must be verified against the linked official source.
